page_title: TOU 5-1 NIC | Toulouse v Nice 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Toulouse.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Toulouse enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
85' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Today's match ends for Elye Wahi who will be replaced by Charles Vanhoutte (Nice).
82' Pape Demba will be replaced by Mario Sauer (Toulouse).
82' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is being substituted because of an injury. Carles Martinez sends Noah Edjouma on the pitch.
82' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Rasmus Nicolaisen and he is replaced by Seny Koumbassa (Toulouse).
80' 5 - 1 Julian Vignolo (Toulouse) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
78' The number of shots on goal at present is 8:6.
75' It is time for a substitution. Julian Vignolo (Toulouse) is on for Santiago Hidalgo.
74' 4 - 1 Goal! Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 4:1.

71' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Guillaume Restes makes a comfortable save.
71' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
70' Claude Puel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ali Abdi (Nice) replacing Melvin Bard.
69' The corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is cleared away by the defence.
69' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Nice win a corner.
67' It will be a substitution. Kevin (Nice) is ready to enter the pitch as Everton Pereira walks off.

67' Tiago Gouveia (Nice) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Guillaume Restes tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
63' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) works the corner short.
61' A yellow card for a tackle by Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse). Gael Angoula doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
59' Nice are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) replaces Alexis Vossah.

55' 3 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) unleashes a quick low drive into the middle of the net and past the goalkeeper. Here is an example of luck being on your side.
53' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Tom Louchet (Nice) but poses no threat.
51' Morgan Sanson (Nice) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Gael Angoula didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
49' 2 - 1 Goal! Elye Wahi (Nice) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:1.
48' Morgan Sanson (Nice) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
46' Here is a change. Isak Jansson is going off and Claude Puel gives the last tactical orders to Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice).
46' It's time for a substitution. Tiago Gouveia (Nice) comes on in place of Tanguy Ndombele.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+3' What a save from Guillaume Restes! Isak Jansson (Nice) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 0 Frank Magri (Toulouse) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
45' Morgan Sanson (Nice) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Gael Angoula no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to Toulouse.
43' Frank Magri (Toulouse) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
40' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Juma Bah (Nice) for a tough tackle.
40' Juma Bah (Nice) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse have a free kick.
39' Great teamplay by Nice as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
37' Gael Angoula blows his whistle after Jonathan Clauss (Nice) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

34' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box straight towards the underside of the crossbar. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save.
34' Pape Demba (Toulouse) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

33' Frank Magri (Toulouse) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner. However, he couldn't beat Maxime Dupe, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. Now Toulouse have a corner.
33' Pape Demba (Toulouse) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing.
31' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
30' Melvin Bard (Nice) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
27' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

22' Golden chance! Tom Louchet (Nice) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.

21' Frank Magri (Toulouse) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
19' Morgan Sanson (Nice) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Gael Angoula stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Toulouse are awarded the free kick.
18' Toulouse control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
15' Isak Jansson (Nice) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
12' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
11' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

7' 1 - 0 Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) receives a sweet pass into the box that puts him in a one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He accepts this chance and rips a shot into the top left corner. Brilliant finish!
5' Pape Demba (Toulouse) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Nice have a free kick.
3' Guillaume Restes blocks Morgan Sanson (Nice)'s effort from the edge of the box.
1' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Gael Angoula will referee today's match.
